items.title: 价值近 100 万美元的 PSA 分级神奇宝贝和其他交易卡在 PSA 总部外被盗
items.summary: Refunds will be issued to affected parties.

content.v: I don't send my Pokémon cards off to PSA to get graded. I'm too emotionally attached to my cards to ever sell them, so paying the hefty fee for grading doesn't really make sense for me, plus I'm a naturally anxious person. So when I heard the latest news of almost $1 million worth of TCG being stolen right outside PSA's headquarters my position was cemented.

Police in Santa Ana, California have confirmed the theft of an estimated $963,000 worth of TCG after several card collectors were notified that a truck carrying their collections had been burglarised back in mid-October.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/YfbrLzatbVa8eehzF9cDDN-1920-80.png

"The pallets contained various trading cards, including, but not limited to, sports cards and Pokémon cards," the SAPD explained to The Athletic . "The exact value of the stolen items has not yet been determined, pending further investigation. The investigation remains ongoing. Anyone with information regarding this incident is encouraged to contact the Santa Ana Police Department."

But what exactly happened, and how did two pallets holding around 100 packages get stolen? Well, according to reports a FedEx driver left their truck unattended outside PSA's Santa Ana office for around 60 to 90 minutes. This left enough time for the thieves to break off the lock to the truck and make away with all the packages.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/Q9gwogWHYq9tmbEBJiL6fN-1920-80.png
FedEx released a statement to ABC7 reassuring customers that "the security of our customers' shipments is a top priority, and we are working with local law enforcement in their investigation."

PSA has also confirmed in a statement to IGN that it has promised to refund customers affected. It will hand them out "based on fair market value up to the maximum insured value" of the cards and has deactivated the certificates of all the stolen goods.

This is another sad incident in an increasingly long line of TCG thievery. Just a few months ago two men pleaded guilty to stealing over £71,000 worth of Pokémon TCG, and TCG shops have seen an increase in burglaries over the past few years as card prices go up. With no sign of it getting better I feel as if the only fix is for The Pokémon Company to flood the market, devaluing cards, and thereby removing the incentive to resell. Because let's be honest, a piece of cardboard shouldn't be selling for $70,000.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/6offQUY4CXebir2TC27dMd-1920-80.jpg

items.title: 百思买 (Best Buy) 正在以建议零售价出售《精灵宝可梦 TCG：棱柱进化》ETB，但您需要获得邀请
items.summary: Best Buy is offering Pokémon TCG: Prismatic Evolutions ETBs for $49.99, around 62% below market price. Here's

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/20/pokemon-tcg-pristmatic-evolutions-elite-trainer-box-cover-1792501102180.jpg

In a world where market price has become the new MSRP for the Pokémon Trading Card Game , you can now score one of its rarest modern ETBs — Prismatic Evolutions — for only $49.99 at Best Buy , thanks to the retailer’s new invite-only listing.

Amazon’s invite-only listings for Pokémon TCG Elite Trainer Boxes and bundles have been one of the best ways to score trading cards at MSRP without having to check multiple in-person retail stores or trying to beat scalper-bots during online drops. However, their now-huge popularity has made the odds of getting one of those said invites a ‘once in a blue moon’ sort of opportunity these days.

Seeing that obvious growing issue in the retailer market, that’s likely why Best Buy has been launching sales events like this itself. Instead of paying around $130.50 for a Prismatic Evolutions Elite Trainer Box (its current market price on TCGplayer ), you can pay around 62% less if you’re lucky enough.
Said luck is still the most important factor of all here, though, as that essentially determines if you’ll be able to get one of these Pokémon ETBs for yourself.
First, you’ll need a Best Buy account, and you’ll need to be signed in as you select the “Ask for an invite” button on the page.

In the same way as Amazon’s Pokémon invites go out, your invite request will be kept on Best Buy’s system to be in consideration for the next (or future) stock drops the retailer gets for this particular ETB — before randomly selecting who amongst those requesters actually get an invite.

If you do get selected, of which you’ll be notified by email, you’ll have 24 hours to purchase your Prismatic Evolutions ETB before said invite expires. In light of that fairly narrow window, that’s also why Best Buy advises you to download and use the Best Buy app as well, so you can get real-time alert notifications, as well.

Whilst this all means requesting an invite doesn’t guarantee you’ll get selected this time, you’ll at least stay on the list for any future restocks, too, so you don’t need to request one again each time.

As for what you can get when you finally get an invite, the standard Prismatic Evolutions Elite Trainer Box includes nine Prismatic Evolutions booster packs, an exclusive full-art foil Eevee promo card, 65 Eevee-themed sleeves, 45 Energy cards, dice, condition markers, a player's guide, and a collector's storage box.

items.title: GTA 6 将包含许多小细节，例如 Red Dead 的动态马睾丸物理
items.summary: New details about Rockstar's GTA 6 continue to come to light ahead of the highly anticipated crime game's rele

content.v: New details about Rockstar's GTA 6 continue to come to light ahead of the highly anticipated crime game's release in November. Reporter Jason Schreier published a video recently in which he discussed some of the new things about GTA 6 that he learned when interviewing Rockstar, including how the game will feature the next evolution of fine details like the horse testicle system in Rockstar's last game, Red Dead Redemption II, along with information about the game's roads and "dark" years of development on the project.

One of the details is that GTA 6's roads are narrower, generally, than what GTA 5 had--and that was on purpose. The roads are "significantly" narrower, Schreier said that Rockstar's Aaron Garbut told him, and players will have denser traffic scenarios to deal with. Anyone who's played GTA 5 knows that some of the roads are wide open, allowing players to zip around like an action movie.
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/GTA_5c11e2.jpg?w=636

Players can do that in GTA 6 as well, but Schreier said Rockstar told him that the team planned on narrower roads from the onset of development, and this caused "ripple effects" for the game overall. "All these things come back to bite you later," Garbut said, referring to how narrower roads meant that the team had to create more buildings and generally more elements to accomodate this.

Also in the video, Schreier said Rockstar faced "dark" times between 2019-2022 due to not only COVID, but also because that was when Rockstar was determing how realistic they wanted to make GTA 6. Finding the balance between realism and the arcade-style fun that GTA is known for was a key point of discussion at Rockstar around this time, and it caused some tension internally, Schreier said.

Around this time, Rockstar's Rob Nelson told Schreier that the studio was thinking about making GTA 6's weapon system more realistic and only allowing players to hold a set number of weapons in their arsenal. Rockstar spent "months if not years" experimenting with different designs for a new system to evolve the traditional weapon wheel, or get rid of it entirely. However, after all that time, Rockstar decided to stick with the familiar weapon-wheel setup.

Another interesting fact from the video is that, according to Garbut, there is "no one person that has this whole thing in their head," referring to GTA 6 itself. Schreier said individual developers working on GTA 6 are given a level of autonomy that allows them to add small details that other colleagues might be totally unaware of.

Schreier pointed out how one of the granular details in Red Dead Redemption II was how your horse's testicles would shrink or expand based on the weather. That was never something that was on a "features list" for the game or an idea that a director asked for. Instead, someone, or a team of people, came up with this on their own and put it in the game. Schreier said GTA 6 will have its own version of this, with individual developers or teams inserting granular details that might otherwise go unnoticed.
GTA 6 launches on November 19 for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. It's expected to be a huge hit commercially, and it's already tracking ahead of all the other big AAA games of recent times.

items.title: 美国政府泄露迄今为止最好的 GTA 6 宣传片：Pißwasser 是真的
items.summary: Rockstar appears to be teaming up with a Florida brewery to bring two of GTA's most famous beer brands to life

content.v: Now this is a marketing campaign I can get behind: It looks very much like Rockstar is teaming up with Florida-based brewery Tripping Animals Brewing to bring a trio of Grand Theft Auto 6 -themed beers into the real world. That's right— Pißwasser is finally real.

The discovery was made by Grand Theft Auto site GTAVice.net , which found labels for Pißwasser, Patriot, and No Mames Vice City—a re-branding of Tripping Animals' No Mames Lager—in the US Alcohol and Tobacco Tax and Trade Bureau database .

Sure enough, they're in there, although I had to use Hopgrail to dig up the labels: The No Mames Vice City label was approved on October 9, while the Pißwasser and Patriot labels followed on October 15.
So what's in the cans?
NO MAMES VICE CITY
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/i5n2Xb7YXeckQ9ahaKb29P-1920-80.jpg

This looks to be a re-brand of Tripping Animals' No Mames beer, so here's what the brewery's website has to say about it: "Bright gold and effortlessly crisp, No Mames blends flaked corn and traditional malts for a smooth, dry lager with subtle floral hops and a hint of sweetness. Clean, crushable, and brewed for easy drinking, anytime."
Patriot and Pißwasser are not yet on the Tripping Animals site, so for those we will go with what we can pull from the TTB database, which frankly isn't much:
PATRIOT BEER
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/BmP3T33T5BJMPnDLnuoj5P-1920-80.jpg
4.2% ABV American lager

A very American lager, the GTA Fandom Wiki says Patriot Beer is possibly inspired by Sam Adams, although it notes that the color scheme of the label is more akin to PBR. Personally I think it's more likely a prescient take on Real American Beer , which is basically a GTA-style parody beer, except it's real. Real American .
PIßWASSER
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/pDrMBtgVB8bB9ewUF53LCP-1920-80.jpg
4.2% ABV lager

The king of GTA beers, Pißwasser is of course a pilsner, it says so right on the label. Now, your local beer nerd is probably leaning forward in his chair to tell you that pilsner is a type of lager, but my local beer nerd, who is me, says that yes, that is technically correct, but it's important to be specific about these things. Otherwise you get people telling you that Rolling Rock and Warsteiner are basically the same, and next thing you know you're in a fistfight with Bill from your grade 10 geography class and then somebody calls the cops and you end up running through people's back yards and tripping over shit and ripping your pants, and nobody gets any beer. Who needs that kind of chaos?

Anyway, none of these brews are confirmed as actually happening at this point, although given their appearances in the TTB database, not to mention Rockstar's largesse with its rental of basically the entire state of Florida to promote GTA 6, it's all but certainly real. It's also an obvious fit, particularly given the meta-popularity of GTA's in-game beer brands.

The bigger question for me is, how do I get some? Promo beers tend not to be great, but No Mames holds a very respectable 85 rating on Beeradvocate , and Tripping Animals seems quite well regarded overall. And let's not forget the all-important bottom line here: it's beer .

Sadly for me (and anyone else not living in Florida who'd like to score a few cans) Tripping Animals distribution appears quite limited: The brewery's website indicates its beers are only available in and around—you guessed it—Miami. Ah well.
Grand Theft Auto 6 is set to launch on consoles on November 19. I would expect the GTA beers to show up by then too.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/ZF5ZJsyvbhJRVSDmd9H3jA-1920-80.jpg

items.title: GTA 6 可能会给美国带来非常昂贵的病假
items.summary: Everyone wants to play Rockstar Games' upcoming heist-'em-up Grand Theft Auto 6 --so much so that some 1.5 mil

content.v: Everyone wants to play Rockstar Games' upcoming heist-'em-up Grand Theft Auto 6 --so much so that some 1.5 million Americans are projected to call in sick to work on November 19 to play the game, which an economics professor estimates will set the country back roughly $1 billion.

According to an International Business Times report , economics professor José García Montalvo projected that the 1.5 million workers planning to play hooky to traipse around Leonida next month could cost America a boatload of money. If each worker has an annual salary of $70,000, Montalvo suggests that the math works out to $1 billion, with GTA 6 publisher Take-Two Interactive estimated to make that same amount on November 19.

That's the catch. The American economy isn't necessarily losing money; the bills are just changing hands, from the pockets of the country writ large to those of one multi-billion-dollar corporation. I'm sure you know the saying: The rich get richer.
It's worth noting, though, that this isn't an official forecast. Rather, Montalvo's estimation is a mere academic projection.

However, the phenomenon has a precedent in the hype surrounding Grand Theft Auto 5 's launch in September 2013, when an IGN poll found that 46% of its nearly 11,000 respondents planned to take the day off work as a holiday for "GTA flu." That self-selected poll measured readers' intentions, not actual workplace absences across US cities like Los Angeles and New York. Still, it's evidence that Rockstar Games' games are a moment in pop culture, creating a monoculture we haven't had in a minute.

And some people are very serious about taking time off to play the game. Bud Burruss, a streamer and father of three, told the Wall Street Journal in September that he plans to take a five-day vacation. Others took to social media to share similar sentiments, with some couples drafting contracts and labeling the act of playing the game as "cheating." Even the military is offering some days off for its soldiers at Fort Stewart, Georgia, to play GTA 6, so you know the "GTA flu" is real.

items.title: Everything Coming to Cyberpunk 2077 With the 2.5 Update, Including New Side Quests, New Double Trouble Perk, and Much More
items.summary: CD Projekt has revealed what to expect from the Cyberpunk 2077 2.5 update, which ties in with the release of N

others.title: 赛博朋克 2077 更新 2.5 中的所有新内容

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/21/screenshot-2026-10-21-165756-1792598292233.png
CD Projekt has revealed what to expect from the Cyberpunk 2077 2.5 update, which ties in with the release of Netflix anime Edgerunners 2 .

Edgerunners content includes a new side quest called Clampdown, which is set before the events of Edgerunners 2 ( CD Projekt recently confirmed that Edgerunners 2 is set in 2078 , just one year after the game itself). During this quest you’ll get a new 5-piece gear set based on the character King from Season 2. There’s also a new radio station that has tracks from the Edgerunners series.

But there’s plenty more coming with 2.5 unrelated to Edgerunners, including more side quests. The Welcome to Paradise! side quest takes you on a journey to uncover a mystery and explore Night City on a guided tour narrated by Richard Night, the founder of Night City itself. There’s also a new side quest that acts as an extension of Fool on the Hill, which includes new tarot cards.

Meanwhile, 2.5 lets you customize your hand cyberware, which will let you give your Mantis Blades, Gorilla Arms, Monowire or Projectile Launch System implants a new look. Each Glamdoc is located in a unique shop, along with their own intro scene with voiceover and animations, and offers a unique catalog of cyberware skins with customizable colors.

Perhaps the most significant addition with 2.5 is the new Double Trouble perk in the Cool tree, which lets you dual-wield Pistols and Revolvers from the Power category for the first time. The hope is that the perk will enable an entirely new playstyle, and I’m sure fans will get a kick out of trying it out.

Elsewhere, there’s cross-platform mod support on PC, Mac, PlayStation 5, PlayStation 5 Pro and Xbox Series X and S, and various quality-of-life improvements, such as saves in the “Load Game” menu grouped by separate playthroughs, and, finally, an FOV (Field Of View) slider on consoles.

On the tech side of things, there’s support for DLSS 4.5, including up to 6X Multi Frame Generation or Dynamic Multi Frame Generation, and the 2nd Generation Transformer Model, and various performance improvements.

Overall, 2.5 is a welcome surprise for Cyberpunk 2077, after CD Projekt had indicated it had no plans for further DLC for the hugely successful game. Of course, The Witcher 3 is getting a new expansion 12 years after launch, so perhaps CD Projekt will return later on with a new expansion for Cyberpunk 2077. For now, though, 2.5 is sure to spark a return to Night City for lapsed players, and give fans of Edgerunners a push to jump in if they haven’t already.

items.title: 独家 — 查看《星际迷航》中的 7 张新卡牌，其中一张记住了 TNG 最具标志性的饮料
items.summary: Magic: The Gathering: Star Trek is the card game's final frontier of 2026, and while Wizards of the Coast reve

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2023/08/24/ste-1692892641332.png

Magic: The Gathering: Star Trek is the card game's final frontier of 2026, and while Wizards of the Coast revealed quite a few of the cards yesterday, IGN today has seven cards we can exclusively reveal ahead of the November 13 release date.

Just like the Marvel Superheroes set that came out earlier this year, Magic: The Gathering Star Trek has cards from pretty much every era of the show's history. Even the small selection of cards we have here covers everything from the original series to Deep Space 9 and Lower Decks.
MTG Star Trek Exclusive Card Reveals
We're revealing seven exclusive Magic: The Gathering Star Trek cards:

The star of the show is a common artifact called 'Tea, Earl Grey, Hot.' Really, the reason why this card is noteworthy is because of the reference to Captain Picard's hot beverage of choice, but in the right deck, it could do some work. It's simply a 2 mana artifact with the 'Food' subtype, which automatically makes it useful in some decks.

But unlike the Food Tokens we've all made hundreds of, this one nets you a card when it enters. When you sacrifice it, you can either gain 3 life like any other Food Token, or you can have it deal 2 damage to an opponent. Finally, I can just throw tea in someone's face.

The more mechanically interesting card is Mirror Universe Intrusion. It's a sorcery for a colorless, a blue and a black, that lets you create a copy of a creature an opponent controls, only it has menace. That's a flavor win, but something that you can do with countless other cards.

However, if you pay the kicker of 4 colorless, a blue and a black, you instead copy all of your opponent's creatures, and give them all menace. At nine mana, it's quite an investment, but a good way to essentially steal an opponent's board.
Mirror Universe Intrusion also has a couple of 'booster fun' treatments, with a borderless version and the new showcase treatment that loos like it came right out of a Star Trek box set.

Dahar Master is a 4-mana 4/3 at common, and with its ability to sacrifice a nonland permanant to shock any target, should be useful at your prerelease. But it's kind of one of those cards that's going to end up populating a bulk box the day after you open it in a pack.

Unexplored Wilds is interesting, becuase it's an effect we've seen countless times with cards like Evolving Wilds, but worse. You can tap it for a colorless mana, unlike Evolving Wilds, but if you want to sacrifice it to tutor up a basic land, you need to spend one mana to do it, which is bad. Just like Dahar Master, this will probably be useful in draft to help you color fix, but it's going to end up in your bulk box the moment you get home.

This new Star Trek set is shaping up to at least be the most interesting Universes Beyond set of the year so far, and I am interested to see how some of the artifact strategies play out across different formats. This set is also getting previewed after Wizards of the Coast revealed Darkhold Destiny at an NYCC panel , which takes a Universes Beyond property and creates a wholly original story.

content.v: Peak-aboo.
In case you missed it, one of 2025's biggest hits — Peak — is heading onto PS5 at last. As it turns out, this isn't the only so-called "friendslop" game bound for Sony's console in the near future.

Friendslop is a term coined to describe a particular brand of online co-op games, with Peak being a great example. Others might include things like Content Warning , or even Escape the Backrooms — basically any co-op game with a lower budget that's built for chaos.

items.title: “犯罪分子听说他们是做GTA6的，就把自己违法犯罪的事全抖搂出来了”
items.summary: 近期，彭博社记者 Jason Schreier 发表了关于《GTA 6》开发幕后的深度特稿《制作GTA6（The Making of Grand Theft Auto VI）》，我们也在之前有过报道。 由于特稿受到篇幅、

content.v: 近期，彭博社记者 Jason Schreier 发表了关于《GTA 6》开发幕后的深度特稿《制作GTA6（The Making of Grand Theft Auto VI）》，我们也在之前有过报道。
由于特稿受到篇幅、行文结构以及官方口径的限制，许多具体细节未能完全展开，或最终被删减。
随后，Schreier 在其个人 YouTube 频道（One Take Schreier）接连发布了两期视频，补充了大量在采访和调研中获取的幕后故事与记者视角。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14534/b5f717df8a70c5adb2be3999aca1b98c.appmsg_mw680water
这两期视频提供了不少值得关注的新信息，为方便大家了解，这里我们对有价值的信息增量做了一些整理：
一、 游戏设计与系统细节：纠结、取舍
在彭博社的文章中，关于游戏设计主要聚焦于“双主角同行机制”和“便利店买啤酒的拟真度讨论”。而在视频里，Schreier 披露了更多具体的玩法细节和设计走过的弯路：
比前作更窄的道路与交通代价
在《GTA 5》的洛圣都中，马路被设计得非常宽敞，玩家可以像玩赛车游戏一样轻松在车流中穿梭，几乎感受不到真实的城市拥堵。但在《GTA 6》立项之初，开发团队就决定将道路收窄、增加车流密度。美术总监 Aaron Garbut 坦言，这个早期的决定后来让团队“自食苦果”——更窄、更密集的道路意味着周围必须填充数量庞大得多的建筑和街景细节，这直接导致了场景构建工作量的成倍增加。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14534/db1e5bd81a0dffd39d765d55435d5fab.appmsg_mw680water
折腾数月最终回到原点的“武器轮”
《GTA 6》延续了《荒野大镖客：救赎2》（以下简称《大镖客2》）的写实思路，玩家不能像老 GTA 那样随身携带无限的武器和火箭筒，而是需要规划有限的武器配置（Loadout）。

但团队当时产生了一个顾虑：如果继续沿用传统的“武器轮（Weapon Wheel）”UI，轮盘上的空白格子会不会时刻提醒玩家“你带不了那么多枪”，从而带来挫败感？为此，UI 和设计团队花费了数月甚至上年的时间，尝试了托盘式（Trays）、网状（Webs）乃至完全取消轮盘等无数种替代方案。结果在经历了漫长的迭代后，他们发现还是原版最好，最终在成品里又改回了传统的武器轮。这也是项目在 2019—2022 年“黑暗期”内耗的一个缩影。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14534/77d5fed0bc6232256735f87737cd7621.appmsg_mw680water
动态的“出汗系统”
彭博社文章开篇仅用半句话戏谑地提到了“最逼真的汗水刻画”，视频则解释了这其实是一套专门编写的脚本系统：主角 Jason 和 Lucia 会根据当前的体力消耗程度流不同量的汗。比如在夜店里如果跳舞跳得格外卖力，角色身上的汗水就会明显多于平时。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14534/afbb6cd60923f1245ff55c8df68dba06.appmsg_mw680water
《大镖客2》核心交互系统的诞生秘辛
《大镖客2》中广受好评的“左扳机键（L2）问候/挑衅路人”系统，深刻影响了后续《GTA 6》的世界构建。视频透露，这个系统的原型是由动画副总裁 Mark Tennant 在 2014 或 2015 年左右私下做出来的。
当时另一位开发负责人 Phil Hooker 甚至不太敢把这个原型拿给创意负责人 Rob Nelson 看，因为 Nelson 在内部以“野心极大、什么都想往游戏里塞、不计工作量后果”而闻名。结果 Nelson 看到后当场拍板，认为这将彻底革除以往“只能拿枪指着路人”的单一交互。这一决定最终衍生出了海量的动画、配音和脚本工作。
开发者自发塞入的“隐藏彩蛋”

由于《GTA 6》体量过于庞大，Aaron Garbut 直言“公司里没有任何一个人能在脑子里装下这整个游戏”。他借此澄清了一个著名传闻：《大镖客2》里“马的睾丸随天气冷暖收缩”并不是高管或美术总监下达的硬性指标，而是底层开发者在资源和时间充裕的情况下，利用自主权自发做进去的细节。《GTA 6》同样保留了这种允许开发者自由发挥的空间，因此即便游戏发售，许多隐藏细节可能连 Rockstar 最高层的主创自己都没见过。
迈阿密全职驻扎与考察轶事
为了还原罪恶都市，Rockstar 不仅频繁派团去迈阿密，甚至在当地安排了几名全职工作人员常驻。在考察期间，他们跟随当地警察出警或接触当地三教九流的人物时， 对方只要一听说他们是做《GTA》的，就会立刻打开话匣子，迫不及待地把自己和朋友这辈子干过的所有违法犯罪的事全都抖搂出来。
技术高级副总裁 Jonathon Ashcroft 在迈阿密的夜店度过了自己的 40 岁生日。当时的画面非常滑稽：一群皮肤白皙的苏格兰技术宅，和周围狂欢的人群格格不入， 在夜店里走来走去只为了凑近研究打光和节奏同步。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14534/e3b9fc046d39dec0e66ed7a137a4b9dd.appmsg_mw680water
二、 团队扩招与内部管理：制片人文化的利与弊
彭博社文章提到了公司人数从 2,441 人翻倍至 4,711 人，并清退了部分恶劣的管理层。视频则进一步拆解了这种规模膨胀带来的管理机制剧变：
如何打破巨型项目管理的虚假预期
为了管理近 5,000 人的庞大团队并避免恶性加班，Rockstar 大举引入了数据化管理。
过去如果给美术师派一个任务，要求一周做完，但实际需要两周， 美术师为了保质往往会默默加班赶出来；这会导致管理层误以为“这类任务一周就能搞定”，从而在后续排期中形成恶性循环。 现在庞大的制片团队通过大量的图表和评估指标来追踪进度， 核心目的之一就是打破这种虚假预期 ，进行更符合实际的工时估算。不过这也带来了大公司官僚化和层级变多的副作用，让部分习惯自由沟通的老员工感到不适。
1:1 调休
Rockstar 推行的加班补偿机制，具体运作方式是“自愿加入（Opt-in）”， 员工在核心工时之外（如夜晚和周末）每多工作 1 小时，就能兑换 1 小时的带薪休假 ，预计在项目结束后集中休完。
三、 泄密与严苛管控的反噬
泄密与反泄密是GTA6开发过程中的重要一环，且不仅一次泄密，对R星内部的开发造成了深远的影响。
四、数十年如一日的团队延续性
最后，Schreier花了相当长的篇幅，跳出具体事件，总结了为什么只有 Rockstar 能做出《GTA》这样如此特别、鲜活且细节惊人的游戏—— 核心原因在于其高层与骨干团队数十年如一日的稳定性与延续性 。
在 Rockstar， 不仅是最高层的三位开发负责人（Nelson、Garbut、Hooker）在公司待了至少二十年以上，他们下面各个层级的大量核心开发人员，也都在一起共事了 20 到 30 年， 共同交付过一部又一部大作。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14534/d68021161dba149c44aef09be038861b.appmsg_mw680water
在游戏开发领域，“一个团队曾一起完整地把游戏做出来并推向市场”是无可替代的宝贵资产。只有一起经历过这种战火的淬炼，团队内部才能形成一种无需多言的默契，学会如何在意见不合、冲突和摇摆时依然保持沟通并最终达成妥协，推动项目前进。
当前游戏行业（尤其是像 Xbox 等大厂）频繁裁员、解散工作室的做法极其短视。他指出，当一家公司轻易裁掉一个共同交付过游戏的成熟团队时，流失的不仅仅是几个员工，而是毁掉了这种千金难买的协作默契与制度性记忆。
这也解释了为什么《GTA 6》前期会经历剧烈的阵痛：当工作室规模突然翻倍到4700 多人时，瞬间涌入了成千上万名“从未与 Rockstar 一起交付过游戏”的新人，老团队必须花极大的精力去教导和磨合，带他们适应 Rockstar 的开发方式。 但一旦度过了这个磨合期，这套耗费八年多时间重建的引擎、工具链以及磨合成熟的庞大团队，就成了极其稳固的地基。
正如当年他们在2001年完成《GTA 3》的基础建设后，仅用不到一年时间就在其框架上做出了《罪恶都市（Vice City）》一样；主创们相信，既然这次已经完成了底层的彻底重构且“不打算再推倒重来”，未来无论是制作《GTA 6》的 DLC、扩展内容、在线模式还是下一部新作，产出节奏都将比这次快得多。

content.v: 去年9月，在上海举办的罗技G趣玩日上，我第一次摸到了GPW5的演示机。
当时这款新鼠标最核心的创新，是率先搭载了“触觉电感触发系统”HITS。
这项技术简单来说，是用电磁感应来判定按键是否触发，再通过模拟的触觉反馈，让手指感受到一次“点击”。由此，玩家可以完全自定义左右键各自按到多深才触发、抬起多少就能再次触发，以及震动反馈究竟要“硬”一些还是“脆”一些。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14532/96757bf14b7207e155d083b65ac37633.gif_mw680
今年2月份，我拿到了一台正式发售版本的GPW5雪豹实机——它的点击手感确实独特。在连击测试中，我也点出了比原来用的GPW4小狗版更高、更稳定的频率。
手感之外，HITS取消了传统机械微动触点，也就避开了这类触点损耗或是品控造成的连击问题。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14532/c0c99013f41af29d9f7aaebb1916ae3f.appmsg_mw680water
此后这只GPW5就直接成为了我所有场景下的主力鼠标。我的身边也有同事和朋友入手了这台鼠标，结果都是“用了就放不下”，甚至连出差都带着。
当然，不少玩家对于GPW5仍保持着观望态度——一是作为一项新技术的落地项目，它的应用效果、长期体验、品控是否可靠，乃至确认罗技自身对于这项技术究竟是抱着试水心态，还是下了决心要长期投入，都需要时间来验证。
二是作为一款定位专业级的电竞鼠标，GPW5的1399元价格和早期供不应求的货源，对于许多玩家来说仍旧算是一道门槛。大家也在看行业里的其他厂商是否会吸取这项创新，带来面向不同市场定位的平替产品。
现实是，一年多过去，行业里确实有一些厂商公开了包括光磁、电磁微动等在内的类似方向的方案，但产品落地并没能像大家预期中那样快速。
倒是在今年举办的罗技G趣玩日活动上，罗技率先带来了GPW5的升级款GPW5 ULTRA。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14532/5c9dd089fcd409905653505e2f6091d8.appmsg_mw680water
GPW5 Ultra公布后便已正式发售
这一回，我们在第一时间拿到了一台GPW5 ULTRA（海外型号PRO X3 SUPERSTRIKE），到现在也已进行了近一个月的深度体验。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14532/54a2af7007e7e6dad87c4b86cce31e43.appmsg_mw680water
GPW5 Ultra（左）与GPW5（右）
GPW5 ULTRA的外形和HITS技术都延续了年初推出的GPW5雪豹，但重量从61克降到了约59克——这样的变化在实物手感上的差异还挺明显，开箱后初次拿起来时，一度让我怀疑自己是不是在原本用的那版上加过配重。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14532/88a83fa28f4cebbec2c2ac7f136fd251.appmsg_mw680water
实际不带接收器进行称重对比，新旧两款的重量差可以达到3g
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14532/6e3481a6140411e33255d4de29b11f91.appmsg_mw680water
两款的接收器倒有了不小的变化，Ultra的变得更小
罗技G首席产品官、“GPW之父”Chris Pate，也在趣玩日的媒体采访环节提到：旧版本发布后，职业选手和普通玩家都有反馈说，觉得鼠标的重量分布有些靠前。他们很重视这项意见，因此新款重新调整了内部结构，将重心移得更靠中间。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14532/ec1f674d9223076776ebe0726d3b0dd0.appmsg_mw680water
今年也恰好是Chris在罗技工作三十周年
能实现这些，一个重要原因是这次的ULTRA更换了主控芯片，没再继续对着从GPW3时代沿用而来的Nordic nRF52833挤牙膏，而是彻底更换为全新的射频主控NxLOGI，并适配了面积更小的定制PCB主板。
全新主控芯片带来了更高的能效，因此在电池容量不变的情况下，官方承诺的ULTRA续航从90小时提升到了135小时。另外，主按键、侧键和滚轮等部件的输入延迟都有进一步的小幅降低。
在过去8个月里，作为一款应用了新技术的专业电竞鼠标，GPW5算得上站稳了脚跟。
今年5月，专门追踪职业选手设备与设置的ProSettings就公开数据：这款2月才上市的鼠标，在数周内就挤进职业选手使用率前五；在《CS2》PGL克卢日-纳波卡站进行期间，当时仍在争夺冠军的50名选手中，就有13人已转向使用这款鼠标。
到10月时，ProSettings记录的使用GPW5的专业选手已有182名，并就此评价：没人再会说HITS技术只是项噱头。如今ULTRA款针对选手反馈所做的升级，则进一步补齐了产品可能存在的短板。
作为一个电竞水平比较普通的玩家，Ultra这些纸面上的提升对我而言确实比较微妙。
一个比较直观的感受，倒是鼠标与G HUB软件配合起来更稳定了，使用原版时偶尔出现的、像是软件影响了DPI而导致灵敏度短暂变化的情况，在使用升级款的过程中没再出现。
罗技G全球总经理Robin Piispanen也在采访中说，他们一直有在接收和关注中国用户对于G HUB软件的各种反馈，承认其仍需要改进——罗技G已经在中国设立专门的软件团队，正在推进G HUB下一阶段的体验：“在不久的将来，大家会在G HUB中看到很多新变化。”
对于GPW5这样基于HITS技术、用户可以对使用体验进行高度定制的产品，软件层的支持确实非常重要——例如我在将鼠标从原版换为ULTRA的过程中，最终还是自己去对比和复制了原本的参数，并没能无缝衔接。
不过经过一年的发展，如今GPW5的用户社区生态已经有了不错的发展，职业选手和玩家们分享的针对各种场景的参数也已经非常丰富，也能通过下载数，方便地找到一些热门设置作为参考。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14532/a05657181bd4c5f8e229920ec36126b5.appmsg_mw680water
和大家一样，我也非常关注HITS技术究竟要多久才会被普及到更多型号的鼠标上，给普通玩家甚至非玩家用户带来一些新体验。
Robin的回答是，他完全理解这样的需求，说自己也已很难在日常工作中用回普通鼠标。但目前职业选手们对于HITS的需求就已经超出了预期，在产能有限的前提下，罗技G作为专为竞技而设计的品牌，所以首先要把面向职业选手的产品做好、交付出去，再考虑如何将它应用到更多产品中。
另一方面，围绕着作为鼠标行业旗舰的GPW系列，罗技G也在继续加强旗下产品整体生态的建设。
这次与GPW5 ULTRA一起公布的，就还有PRO X2 RT参天8K磁轴键盘，和PRO X 3 LIGHTSPEED耳机。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14532/afe42ec6f074ddb440c4a3905a4d1469.appmsg_mw680water
其中这款键盘支持自定义触发行程，可在0.1毫米到4毫米之间调整，并支持快速触发——松开按键时不必回到固定的复位点，便可以结束一次输入。这与GPW5放在一起，就比较能呈现异曲同工的设计理念。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14532/3153573b2005926fe2ef10fdbc699af3.gif_mw680
参天上还加强了一个比较方便的设计，玩家通过板载的OLED屏幕，就可以快速调整触发点、快速触发等设置，无需每次都打开G HUB。一键切换至能禁用非游戏按键及组合、避免误触的“游戏模式”也很实用。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14532/6a8c3691cce3625bc7126aa847b93a0d.appmsg_mw680water
手感上，参天配备了罗技定制的预润滑KS20轴体和6层消音结构，实际敲起来的手感比较“实”，触底时有比较明显的承托感，发出的声响却比较干净，没有太多零碎的杂音。
耳机方面，PRO X 3 LIGHTSPEED沿用了50毫米PRO-G石墨烯单元，提供10段均衡器调节，升级了麦克风、头带设计和续航，官方承诺续航时间最高为70小时。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14532/bfbb9797502681f2c65741de75e69cb0.appmsg_mw680water
相对于GPW5而言，这两款产品的革新性没有那么突出，更多是补齐产品的易用性。两款新品放在一起，最显眼的肯定还是粉色的外观。而GPW5 Ultra也已经预告将推出粉色款。
罗技G近几年的产品几乎都不会错过粉色款，职业电竞设备与这个颜色之间形成的反差感，正在成为其代表特色之一。就连Chris在介绍鼠标的新配色时也特意说：“我穿粉色鞋子可不是偶然。”
相比去年，今年在上海M-Hub静安举办的趣玩日空间更大，场景也更开放，横跨多个区域开展了试玩、对战和交流活动。现场玩家人数也比去年有明显的增加。
活动本身还被选为“静安国际广告与品牌创新嘉年华”的分会场，发布会上登台的嘉宾既有玩家熟悉的电竞选手、社群达人，也有静安区政府等方面的官方代表。活动现场，罗技也宣布计划于2027年初在上海静安区成立中国科技研发创新中心。
这是今年3月因“罗技G官方旗舰店”的不当营销视频引发舆论风波、以及罗技中国官方发表致歉之后，罗技G面向国内用户举办的最大规模的主题线下活动——多少能感受到其努力表达诚意的态度。
在这段时间里，罗技G内部也有不小的变化。去年来参加趣玩日时身份还是PRO系列与模拟类产品负责人的Robin，在今年5月正式接任罗技G全球负责人。而在上任不到一个月后，Robin便专门到访中国，与国内的电竞战队交流、参加面向玩家的小型交流活动、甚至和本地网红一起拍段子。
不止在镜头前没有架子，Robin私下也和大家认知中的外企高管不太一样——他仍会在采访间隔主动找我聊两句Dota：仍记得月之女祭司在中文语境下叫“POM”，说自己玩不转新出的英雄凯。
这次趣玩日活动期间，Robin也拍了不少段子视频
在媒体采访中，Robin格外强调了一件事：在电竞方面，罗技G合作的中国和亚洲选手，已经比欧洲和西方选手还多。罗技G在中国也有专门的研发团队，是推动新品研发的重要力量。他和Chris每年会来中国三四次，与这里的团队合作，开展面向亚洲市场的工作。

items.title: 明明是讲朝韩战争的COD23，怎么就写成母鸡卡了？
items.summary: “我从来没觉得在141特遣队开心过。” 今年，《使命召唤：现代战争4》（MW4）照例把“提前试玩剧情”当成了预购奖励。 这一代游戏的主题围绕在朝韩两国之间的对抗 （当然，是虚拟的，本文涉及所有内容也不涉及现实世界） 。朝

content.v: https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14533/bd1c89278517700ccb5d807a54ca4769.appmsg_mw680water
“我从来没觉得在141特遣队开心过。”
今年，《使命召唤：现代战争4》（MW4）照例把“提前试玩剧情”当成了预购奖励。
这一代游戏的主题围绕在朝韩两国之间的对抗 （当然，是虚拟的，本文涉及所有内容也不涉及现实世界） 。朝鲜的形象在全球互联网上都有几分神秘，也有着不低的讨论度，如今有游戏选择公开描写朝鲜，确实给MW4提前拉到不少关注。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14533/bd9c7e7599c26c0c8ca83c2bb75f3752.appmsg_mw680water
但即便如此，考虑到此前《使命召唤》战役愈发糊弄的制作态度，如今单冲着剧情就去买单，多少是有点赌的成分在里面。
结果令很多老玩家都意外的是，这次剧情开放试玩后，MW4成了十几年来评价最好的一代《使命召唤》。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14533/48ee5d3ebe49b9ab578f31fadbc46e28.appmsg_mw680water
是因为做得好吗？是，但也不完全是。
听起来可能有点抽象，但逛一逛社区，不难发现大家对MW4的好评，某种程度很像几年前坚持看完《颂乐人偶（Ave Mujica）》一样。
简单来说就是一到聊剧情，你会想到主角们平时的行为逻辑太过拟人，各种发癫神展开让人叹为观止；可当你撑到结局时，纵然有千言万语想吐槽，但它的表演、唱歌环节又确实是业界独一无二的水平。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14533/ba4e427df33682d66923fc725bad8598.appmsg_mw680water
而想到以后大家再也见不着了，也就笑一笑决定原谅一切。
这就是如今发生在MW4身上的故事。
让《现代战争4》备受好评的主要亮点，确实是剧情回归了久违的正面战场氛围。
这次战役一改前几作小打小闹的特种作战风格，从一名原被迫卷入战火的韩国大兵朴玄俊视角引入，铺开了一场席卷整个半岛的全面战争。前作《现代战争3》里那种拿战区地图敷衍了事的“开放式战斗任务”，如今总算被紧凑的线性演出和大规模巷战所取代。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14533/08144a2fbdb1694a4a9e7d5022ca5f66.appmsg_mw680water
从第一关开始，看着城市在夜幕中沦陷，扮演主角跟着部队在漫天炮火中狼狈撤退时，属于老版《现代战争2》“本土保卫战”的压迫感，确实在很大程度上回来了。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14533/810bcd7e98176d95d7bec4cfa2bf9206.gif_mw680
朝韩线的中期关卡，动视也尝试了一些差异化的调剂。比如前期主要描写正面战场的溃退、固守，中段则是孤身一人的潜行、摸索。
在名为“绝境”的关卡里，制作组塞了一段半岛版“黑鹰坠落”。你扮演的韩国大兵在朝鲜境内坠机，要在一个小型开放世界岛屿里到处探索，四处搜刮武器补给最后端掉对方的据点……
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14533/d9bafc3a3dd68f83b3e06d4fb00a88ce.appmsg_mw680water
你可以慢悠悠做各种小任务补充战力，或者直接做主线
虽然IW明显是在为新的DMZ玩法做宣传，但关卡节奏控制得当，规避了纯线性流程一路往前冲的审美疲劳。玩起来有种《孤岛惊魂》《幽灵行动》的战术潜入感，让我一度产生了“育碧那套玩法放在COD里还挺带劲”的念头。
整个战役用了16个关卡的篇幅推进双线故事：一边是朝韩两边的战事，另一边则是老熟人普莱斯跨国追凶……
为了做出区分，普莱斯一边会有很多注重脚本演出的关卡。像开头就是《疾速追杀》味拉满的追逐战，仅这一幕就证明动视在关卡表现力上，还是有着很深的理解；
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14533/ca89a622ce55f444907fc44ee8bcf619.appmsg_mw680water
而作为解释韩朝战争爆发的暗线，普莱斯的剧情也继承了现代战争系列“满世界打架”的特点，前脚还在纽约大闹酒吧，后脚则又跑到了巴黎街头对抗法国警察，只身把法国搅得天翻地覆。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14533/065da0d9f51c968cc7b22110db1f73be.gif_mw680
普莱斯还会杀警察吗？ 是的你没看错，曾经有勇有谋、坚守正义的普莱斯，在这一代不仅会听信毒枭的话和警察对抗，甚至会为了逃离追捕朝车流扔炸弹。
这也是MW4最让老玩家意难平的一点，过去那些熟悉的经典角色们，在剧情里被写得人设尽失，也基本没能善终。如此哭笑不得的收场命运，尤为体现在《现代战争》系列的核心主角普莱斯身上。
新《现代战争》系列最为烧心的部分，主要是IW在对待141特遣队这些经典角色时的敷衍与恶意。
提起前作剧情最被诟病的地方，就是人气老角色死得极其草率，而普莱斯作为141领队，对战友的死亡毫无真情实感，全然没了老现代战争中“在意队友”的人格魅力。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14533/84885ddc6cc05771bc76a0489348ca33.appmsg_mw680water
出生入死的兄弟阵亡后只说了一句“One KIA”（一人阵亡），这句话也成了COD社区的热梗
到《现代战争4》编剧彻底放飞自我，老角色们全员成了用完即弃的工具人。为了给队友等人报仇， 普莱斯展现出了像被丰川祥子夺舍一般的行为 ，不仅私自暗杀了军方高层，还擅自脱离了自己一手组建起来的141特遣队，拒绝和昔日的队友们交流。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14533/13177389d908a5a7fc80742f9108829d.appmsg_mw680water
成了一个不择手段、自顾自复仇的莽夫。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14533/393b9b3fcd0375879ce2a71cf132b3b0.appmsg_mw680water
为了寻找本作的最终反派、由“拔叔”饰演的“亚契”，普莱斯一度投奔了前作反派女毒枭，为了让毒枭带自己找到目标，心甘情愿给毒枭当打手，在巴黎街头和孟买贫民窟大开杀戒。
这也就有了前面提到的普莱斯大闹巴黎。除了替毒枭对抗黑帮同行，普莱斯后面还和警方大打出手，为了躲避追捕四处飙车碾压路人，在马路上到处扔C4炸弹，完全不顾周围平民的死活：
“这还是141领队吗？这不纯无脑杀人魔吗？”
其实刚玩到这一段，老玩家可能还会替普莱斯找补：“误伤平民”这种事出于游戏性的考量还能勉强接受，但当你坚持推到后续的剧情，就会发现IW就是故意“为了爆而强行安置剧情爆点”，具体就是普莱斯见到任何人都只想着“杀杀杀”。
在剧情开头，和反派做交易的财阀被普莱斯抓到后，没能多说两句就被一枪击毙；
铺垫了几部游戏的系列知名反派马卡洛夫，被普莱斯抓到后活活殴打致死，草草退场；
前来阻止毒贩交易、本身立场正义的雇佣兵格瑞夫斯，被普莱斯抓到后一枪击毙……
这里玩家选放弃就会死，因此必须动手开枪
编剧或许是想刻画普莱斯脱离141后失去了底线，但却没能交代出合理的动机与反应，玩家也只能看着这些老角色一个接一个阵亡，也没有任何额外选择。
与此同时，编剧背弃了普莱斯以往心思缜密的人设。在陪着毒枭霍霍了好几处城市后，普莱斯不考虑个中是否有诈，也不跟昔日战友做任何沟通，最后在幽灵、盖兹等自家兄弟赶来阻拦时，连同一部队的战友也不放过……
做到这种程度之后，这时普莱斯竟然还希望队友相信他的为人
即便付出这么大的代价，普莱斯的所作所为也没换来什么回报，反而促成了剧情进一步突破想象的癫。在把昔日队友杀到只剩下两人后，普莱斯终于如愿有机会见到亚契，结果在交易现场，刚才还谈笑风生的女毒枭被亚契抬手几枪送走；
仅剩的两名队友，系列元老角色盖兹也莫名其妙跟着被一枪送走，连句像样遗言都没留下就领了便当。
是的，MW4目前成了《使命召唤》里死人最多的一作。不论是主角、配角，只要上了台基本就没有好下场，几乎无人善终。过去《使命召唤》塑造这些人物付出的努力，全在这一作被莫名其妙打了水漂。
包括最终BOSS亚契，哪怕请了拔叔出演，亚契直到最后被普莱斯干掉，也没搞出什么毁天灭地的大动静，故事最后就这样以同归于尽的结局草草收场。
到了这一步，再去思考剧情合不合理，确实也没太多意义了，只是让人感叹：即便XBOX的营收压力再大，也真是不差做《使命召唤》的钱，花重金请来的明星只演了一部作品就杀青了。
而之所以敢做得这么绝，可能也是最近动视公开表示。MW4将为近年的“现代战争”系列路线收尾，后续他们的重心会转向全新的《使命召唤》子系列——再不爆没机会了。
与141特遣队的剧本相比，反倒是之前大家调侃居多的朝韩线，总体显得更加平稳一些。

items.title: 你对童年的真实记忆，成了这个国产游戏的恐怖源泉
items.summary: 你对童年的记忆越清晰，这个游戏对你而言或许就越恐怖。 最近，一部名为《叫魂》的国产心理恐怖游戏接连发布了两支预告。 先导预告中的主角以第一人称视角，划亮火柴，探索房屋中的诡谲之处。灵堂、楼梯间、剧院、翡翠宾馆等场景一一闪

content.v: https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14531/cf1c47fbf3ffde27b8b27a42ecf4e907.appmsg_mw680water
你对童年的记忆越清晰，这个游戏对你而言或许就越恐怖。
最近，一部名为《叫魂》的国产心理恐怖游戏接连发布了两支预告。
先导预告中的主角以第一人称视角，划亮火柴，探索房屋中的诡谲之处。灵堂、楼梯间、剧院、翡翠宾馆等场景一一闪过。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14531/28215f59085c48e3f46e09f40a910bd9.appmsg_mw680water
老房子、旧家具与民俗物件带来熟悉感，藏在其中的怪诞形象又让人不安。手掌心里裂生的眼珠、脸上长满菊花的怪物，还有早年街头骗术中的“花瓶姑娘”，都让这支预告片充满了邪典意味。
如果有关注国产恐怖游戏的玩家，也许曾经在四年前刷到过一支《叫魂》的预告和实机片段。不管在当时还是现在，国产游戏中做3D恐怖类型的都算是少数，所以在短时间内，那支视频就已经获得了几十万播放。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14531/8a367e6ff990119c9d548efd26fdc065.appmsg_mw680water
目前你还可以看到这支预告
四年之后，《叫魂》以更完整的姿态回归了。
前段时间，我提前试玩了游戏的部分内容，也前往位于上海漕河泾开拓芯旗下的游戏创业孵化器，采访了子时熄灯工作室的两位主创：制作人兼主美Leaf，以及总监兼主程序Maii。
2023年从中国传媒大学游戏设计专业毕业之后，他们将曾经的毕设作业一步步拓展，做成了现在我们看见的《叫魂》。
看到《叫魂》这个名字的时候，我第一时间想到的是一本同名的、解读乾隆年间巫术恐慌的书。
团队告诉我，两者并没有关联。游戏的名字借用了“叫魂”这一民俗仪式的含义：在人们的观念里，小孩丢了魂魄，大人就去叫他的名字。
他们想要通过游戏唤回的，是游戏故事发生的那个1999年。
Steam的官方介绍页，简述了游戏背景：“欢迎收看《叫魂》，今天是1999年12月31日，首先祝你新年快乐，然后……我们带来了仙女镇终结的讯息。”
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14531/60b5a7310797feb2e751bd6bfc34b16d.appmsg_mw680water
故事由此展开——千禧年前夜，仙女镇究竟发生了什么，以至于整座小镇都成了空城？
玩家将拿起BP机，调查过去的一切。在探索中挖掘居民的陈旧往事，逐渐接近真相。
从我试玩的部分来看，《叫魂》整体的玩法是第一人称步行探索加叙事互动。玩家通过调查环境、收集如信件这样的零碎信息，完成穿插其间的解谜，在变化的场景中互动、推进故事。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14531/681b965278e7df7bfc757a19a94ea4bc.appmsg_mw680water
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14531/7f77a5316530b49993789a5858f3d529.appmsg_mw680water
进入故事的方式，也和这段“欢迎收看”的开场白有点关系。
在进入故事主角的视角之前，玩家会通过BP机获取部分指引，与电视交互，经历一次类似电波转换的过程，再去体验TA的经历。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14531/c10fa6f10c896dfb310159b88fde643d.appmsg_mw680water
这套叙事也延伸到了设计语言中：游戏的设置界面像是一台老式CRT电视，在翻页时会发出细微的电流声。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14531/5ea0bcd9b9277ef797559fd41ef9dde3.appmsg_mw680water
团队告诉我，电视是他们为那个时代选择的标志。随着界面、信号与人物视角的切换，探索故事的过程也仿佛是在观看一段段失落的影像。
进入场景之后，你会发现房屋内的陈设和布局都相当写实。
我试玩的内容是一段更偏情感向的故事，围绕主角的家、楼道和照相馆展开。实际走过的空间不算特别多，但随着流程推进，同一个房间里的人和物会发生变化，空间也会显露出不同的模样。
游戏场景中的门禁、楼道、入户门，甚至是房屋内的家具摆设、装修风格，都很有千禧年味，能够找到曾经生活中的痕迹。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14531/af52180bc978aa951378164e2cf39e1a.appmsg_mw680water
感觉每个人以前家里都有一个这样的转角衣柜
《叫魂》标签里的“心理恐怖”，也正是从这些熟悉的地方开始。比起Jumpscare，《叫魂》更擅长通过生活化的场景，让玩家感到熟悉，再让它逐渐失常，将那些异常与自己过去的经验联系起来。
就拿入户门上张贴的年画娃娃举例，在故事刚开始的时候，看起来只是寻常装饰。到了剧情中期，随着主角的心态出现巨大变化，当我们再次回头时，普通的年画娃娃变成了黑脸。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14531/36bfbbcda386bec146ed8e7f8cda4084.appmsg_mw680water
无尽的楼道中，似乎怎么也找不到正确的那一扇门，楼上和楼下都是一片漆黑，再一回头时，贴着年画娃娃的大门已经布满整个楼道，很难不感到诡异。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14531/3eba16a17fdfa3187a0088b9ccd9123e.appmsg_mw680water
这种熟悉感有一部分来自现实，主角家的布局，就在一定程度上参考了主创Leaf爷爷家的房子，再通过木制家具和装修还原年代感。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14531/18f509f85143cbfe2f14030da9de0923.appmsg_mw680water
游戏中 & Leaf爷爷家的餐厅
虽然团队成员大多出生在2000年前后，但八九十年代置办的家具，到他们记事时往往还在使用。有些甚至一直留到了今天。所以还原这些场景，也是在调用他们自己的生活记忆。
比如游戏中卧室门旁的日历，用的是一个手工弯折的钩子，再拿胶带固定到墙上。
游戏中的交互模式，让故事与场景的结合更加紧密。试玩部分中出现了一只道具相机，玩家可以通过拿起相机拍摄和放下相机，自由切换来自两个不同时空的同一场景，也进一步了解过去发生在主角身上的故事。
此外，为了让玩家感到“熟悉”和“沉浸”，尽管“叫魂”听起来与民俗紧密相关，团队却没有选择大量使用某一种地方仪式。
同时，预告片中的怪物形象，看起来似乎也没有那么“传统”。
团队介绍，《叫魂》中对于民俗元素的运用，基本上是参考一部分再自由发挥一部分，核心原因是想要避免一些过于直接的地域要素。
“如果做跳大神、出马之类的元素，就会很明显地指向东北。我们希望所有人玩这个游戏的时候，会有一个很模糊的印象，觉得‘这好像是什么时候发生的事情’‘好像是我小时候’，但又说不清具体来自于哪里。”
这就给那些邪祟的形象设计留下了空间。对于怪物、邪祟等形象，团队也会从人物的心理和精神状态出发进行设计，让它们与故事中的经历产生联系。
《叫魂》最早的灵感来源于一次课程作业，2022年，几名中国传媒大学的学生将作业剪成了一支概念预告，他们自述是“花两三天时间随便剪的，看到视频火了，我们自己也很惊讶。”
虽然制作仓促，他们想要的方向倒是很早就确定了。
《叫魂》里追求的电影感，和Leaf本人的兴趣有关。他喜欢电影，也尤其爱看恐怖片。从最早版本的《叫魂》开始，团队就在尝试更接近真实的画面，以及电影化的打光、雾气和镜头处理。
到了大四，他们又花两三个月，将它拓展成大约半小时流程的毕设Demo，再次传到了网上。
毕业后，成员原本已经各奔东西，按部就班地进入工作。但这支实机视频被游戏早期投资与孵化品牌开拓芯的工作人员看到了，对方询问他们是否有意愿将《叫魂》做完。
相比在大厂工作，继续做《叫魂》是本来就想做的事情。他们与开拓芯聊过之后“感觉还挺好”：“我们自己也很想做，既然有人这么喜欢，上班也上得不开心，那不如试试看。”
因为更擅长3D，也更希望做出沉浸式的表达，从毕设走向完整游戏，他们首先调整了制作方式：
从Unity转向虚幻引擎，逐渐补齐动画、角色模型和技术美术等岗位，到2024年夏天，团队扩充到约10人的规模。
如今，两支新预告将《叫魂》重新带到了玩家面前。按照团队的介绍，游戏整体开发已完成约七成，预计全流程在6小时左右，多个篇章将通过彼此联系的线索，逐渐串起小镇的往事。
